Weeknotes - June 26, 2026

June 2026

Saturday - June 20, 2026

  • Added an exists() function to the al9000.com site builder. The initial use case is so I can check if there's an og-image.jpg file next to a page and use it if there is.

    This is part of the general way I'm doing things where I rely on naming and location conventions instead of configuring things explicitly.

  • Added the feature to al9000.com that uses the new exists() function to check for an open graph image next to a page and uses it if it exists.

  • Add an RSS feed to the site.
